title: Higher-Order Failure of the Quantum Linear Boltzmann Limit
exact_target: Does periodic quantum scattering agree with Boltzmann transport to second order but fail at each perturbative order above four?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004094 (OWR-16772-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mini-Workshop: Lorentz Gas Dynamics: particle systems and scaling limits (2019), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2019/10, pp. 617--661. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 25.
Quantum Lorentz gas limits (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The question singles out orders greater than four and does not state an answer for third or fourth order. Perturbative agreement through second order is distinct from convergence of the full evolution at fixed coupling.
